about.heading: Who We Are
about.text: We're a game studio based in Nashik, India. We make games we'd want to play — from tactical chess battlers to GPS-powered street games. Small team, real ambition, shipping titles across Play Store and itch.io.

contact.heading: Connect With Us
contact.desc: Got a project, a press inquiry, or just want to say hey — we'd love to hear from you.

hero.title: Build The Future with Elyndor
hero.desc: Hands-on mentorship, real commercial game credits, and direct production experience building indie titles and civic platforms. Explore our active internship programs.
